scientific limitations/integrity: The classification source explicitly supplies the random-graph and random-tournament reduct generators and lists 03C40 among its primary MSC classifications. The orbit formulas are derived from the finite affine action on pair bits and checked exhaustively in small arities. The result concerns numerical tuple-orbit profiles and a binary-orbital non-conjugacy witness for the base groups; it does not classify abstract group isomorphisms or full orbit algebras. Originality is best-of-knowledge after targeted comparison with the source and current literature. Independent audit, formal proof-assistant verification, and expert attestation have not been performed.
title: Orbit-profile isospectrality of the Rado-graph and random-tournament reduct families
